entries.definition:
英 [həˈləʊ] 美 [heˈloʊ] exclamation
A greeting; used when meeting someone. Example: Hello, everyone! Say hello to your friend. Related: hi, welcome, greeting.
A greeting addressed to a whole group; hello used for many people at once.
To greet someone; to say hello to a person you meet.
A polite word or sign of welcome. Hello is the most common English greeting.
An informal greeting, the short form of hello.
A friendly greeting offered to someone arriving; to greet someone kindly.
To make it easier for someone to do something; assistance given to a person.
A hard protective hat worn on the head; a safety helmet.
